fullPassage: In today's marketing and advertising-soaked world, people cannot escape brands. The younger they are when they start using a brand or product, the more likely they are to keep using it for years to come. But that's not the only reason companies are aiming their marketing and advertising at younger consumers. As James U. McNeal, a professor at Texas A&M University, puts it, "Seventy-five percent of spontaneous food purchases can be traced to a nagging child. And one out of two mothers will buy a food simply because her child requests it. To trigger desire in a child is to trigger desire in the whole family." In other words, kids have power over spending in their households, they have power over their grandparents and they have power over their babysitters. That's why companies use tricks to manipulate their minds.

questions.passage: In today's marketing and advertising-soaked world, people cannot escape brands. The younger they are when they start using a brand or product, the more likely they are to keep using it for years to come. But that's not the only reason companies are aiming their marketing and advertising at younger consumers. As James U. McNeal, a professor at Texas A&M University, puts it, "Seventy-five percent of spontaneous food purchases can be traced to a nagging child. And one out of two mothers will buy a food simply because her child requests it. To trigger desire in a child is to trigger desire in the whole family." __________, kids have power over spending in their households, they have power over their grandparents and they have power over their babysitters. That's why companies use tricks to manipulate their minds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: In other words(다시 말해): 앞 내용을 다른 말로 바꿔 설명하는 연결어
det.analysis:
✅ ① In other words(다시 말해): McNeal 교수의 인용문을 '다시 말해' 아이들이 지출에 영향력을 가진다고 환언 ←정답
❌ ② For example(예를 들어): 예시 관계 아님 — 앞 인용문을 요약하는 것
❌ ③ On the contrary(반대로): 역접 관계 아님
❌ ④ As a result(결과적으로): 인과가 아닌 환언 관계

questions.passage: In today's marketing and advertising-soaked world, people cannot escape brands. The younger they are when they start using a brand or product, the more likely they are to keep using it __________. But that's not the only reason companies are aiming their marketing and advertising at younger consumers. As James U. McNeal, a professor at Texas A&M University, puts it, "Seventy-five percent of spontaneous food purchases can be traced to a nagging child. And one out of two mothers will buy a food simply because her child requests it. To trigger desire in a child is to trigger desire in the whole family." In other words, kids have power over spending in their households, they have power over their grandparents and they have power over their babysitters. That's why companies use tricks to manipulate their minds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: for years to come(앞으로 수년간): 어릴 때 시작하면 앞으로 수년간 계속 사용할 가능성이 높다
det.analysis:
❌ ① at the same time(동시에): 문맥과 무관 — 계속 사용한다는 지속 의미 필요
❌ ② from time to time(때때로): 지속적 사용이 아닌 간헐적 사용
✅ ③ for years to come(앞으로 수년간): 어릴 때 브랜드를 시작하면 '앞으로 수년간' 계속 사용할 가능성이 높다 ←정답
❌ ④ once in a while(가끔): 지속적 사용이 아닌 간헐적 사용
det.tip: for years to come = 앞으로 수년간
